company.name: Localyze
company.shortDescription: Localyze is a software to manage your international team: Relocate international hires, temporarily transfer employees.
company.description: Localyze offers a software solution for relocation management. Localyze supports international employees throughout the whole relocation process with an all-in-one software solution covering everything from visa to social integration. Localyze provides an overview of the current relocation process status of all international employees within the relevant categories (visa, insurance, banking) for the recruiting department. Localyze guides internationals through the whole relocation process with a personalized dashboard showcasing next to do's, deadlines and other relevant information. Localyze covers a wide range of topics - ranging from visa and mobile phone contracts to cultural integration. In each category, only relevant information tailored to the individual personality profile is displayed.
